title: AWQ evidence bridge

binding.identifiers: AR-0000, BR-... or OBS-... stable opaque identifiers
binding.digest: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

observation.ordering: Sequences start at 1 and increase by one; IDs and evidence digests are single-use.

projection.rule: The bridge reports observations for AWQ review and never emits accepted, rejected, or quality-passed decisions.

privacy.allowed_values: Stable identifiers, bounded integers, enumerated categories/results, revisions, and SHA-256 digests only.

failure_semantics.side_effects: The model and checker perform no network, provider, process, Git, Coordinator, AWQ, AWG, UI, or LLM operation.

limitations: A valid projection proves only structural consistency of supplied observations.
An observation result is not an AWQ quality decision and a digest does not prove evidence truth.
The standard-library model does not submit evidence, consult AWQ, or enforce Coordinator state.
follow_up: AWQ must independently apply its authoritative requirements and acceptance policy.
A later integration task may transport this projection through an authoritative AWQ contract.
